top_news.title: Stocks in Asia Poised to Edge Down, Yen in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were set to edge lower as tensions in the Middle East pushed oil prices higher, adding to inflation concerns and keeping investors wary about further monetary policy tightening. The yen extended gains to reach its strongest level since February.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 8
top_news.summary: Oil extended gains as traders watched for details of an Iranian deal with Oman to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, which could tighten Tehran’s control over the crucial waterway.

top_news.title: CapitaLand Targets $500 Million for Third Asian Credit Fund
top_news.summary: Singapore’s CapitaLand Investment Ltd. is targeting $500 million in commitments from investors for its third Asia Pacific credit program, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: EM Stocks Jump to Highest Since June as Tech Offsets Higher Oil
top_news.summary: An index tracking emerging-market equities rallied at the start of the week, closing at its highest level in more than two months, as optimism over new AI models helped counter the drag from increased oil prices.

top_news.title: Why Are Japan’s Bond Yields Rising? What’s Driving the Surge
top_news.summary: Government bonds are generally viewed as one of the safest assets to invest in. That’s because it’s considered relatively unlikely that the issuer — a government — will go bankrupt. Among the world’s major government debt markets, Japan’s $7.5 trillion bond market has, for decades, been considered one of the most stable.

top_news.title: Copper Hits All-Time High Amid Tariff Turmoil, Mine Struggles
top_news.summary: Copper surged to its highest-ever price on the London Metal Exchange after a weeks-long rally fueled by anticipation that President Donald Trump will expand US tariffs to imports of refined metal.

top_news.title: High Expectations Leave Stocks Vulnerable: Noviskis
top_news.summary: Jessica Noviskis, OCIO portfolio strategist at Marquette Associates, says strong earnings continue to support US stocks, but elevated expectations and higher yields leave the market vulnerable if results disappoint. “When we do see those hiccups, we can see a bigger correction,” she says on “Bloomberg Markets.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Dangote Courts Retail Investors With $4 Entry to Record IPO
top_news.summary: Billionaire Aliko Dangote has opened up ownership of his Nigerian refinery to ordinary Africans for as little as $4 apiece, calling it an initial public offering “for the people.”

top_news.title: European Stocks Muted as Oil Prices Climb and Novartis Falls
top_news.summary: European stocks were weighed down Monday by higher oil prices and a drop in Novartis AG following the failure of a heart drug.

top_news.title: Gold Edges Lower as Traders Focus on Oil Price Swings and Dollar
top_news.summary: Gold edged lower, as traders monitored volatile oil prices and the yen’s movements against the US dollar.
